_comment: Declared intent: the CI checks that MUST be in main's branch-protection required set. tools/required_checks_gate.py fails on drift in either direction (declared-but-unenforced = a gate that never blocks; enforced-but-undeclared = a gate nobody reviewed). Edit this file only alongside an intentional branch-protection change. tools/ci_gate_runability.py and tools/ci_needs_skip_guard.py read required_contexts and FAIL if any name has no job in .github/workflows.

notes.ci (0..3): The 4-way python shard matrix from .github/workflows/ci.yml. All four shards gate; a shard missing here would let its slice of the suite fail silently.
notes.windows: The Windows aggregator job. Never rename it -- the required-check context is matched by name, so a rename silently drops the gate.
notes.pr-footprint-gate: Required on purpose since 2026-10-07 (STATE.md). Declared here after the 2026-10-14 drift audit (adv-enforcement F-11) found it enforced by branch protection but undeclared.
notes.pr-symbol-survival: Guardrail G13 blocking gate (ci.yml job pr-symbol-survival, tools/pr_symbol_survival_check.py). Required in branch protection since 2026-10-15; declared here so the drift gate sees it. The job has no name: key, so its check context is the job id.
